Notify signal handling clears the dedicated thread flag with ordering after atomic operations while setting occurs exactly once alongside an interruptible wakeup attempt and escalates to a processor kick when the target remains asleep.

Pending state queries treat the notify indicator like a signal for wait interruption while distinguishing fatal interest by kill signal membership combined with general pendingness and gating reporting on interruptible or killable sleep states.
Restarting a system call marks the current thread as having pending signal work and reports interruption without automatic restart.
Fault handling treats a retrying fault as signal interrupted when a fatal signal awaits or when user mode execution has any pending signal work.
Signal wakeup optionally clears stopped and traced job control marks and selects an expanded wakeup set for fatal delivery or for ptrace resumption otherwise using the default wakeup.

Deferred signal mask restoration exists in two exclusive forms one using a thread flag and the other a dedicated boolean field each supporting set plus per task clear and current clear with test and test and clear operations while helpers restore the saved mask and choose between live and saved masks.

Alternate signal stack determination respects stack growth direction and size configuration while treating autodisarmed stacks as never occupied plus distinguishing disabled versus on stack reporting with reset to a disabled empty state and selecting the alternate base for stacks requesting on stack delivery when not already there.
